apc/ar201@1.description: The APC NetShelter two-post open frame rack, 45U, with tapped #12-24 holes. Equipment is mounted on the front rails only, to a depth of 1048 mm.
apc/ar201@1.name: ar201

part-numbers.AR201: APC NetShelter Open Frame Rack, 2 Post, 45U, 12-24 Threaded Holes, Black

apc/ar203a@1.description: The APC NetShelter four-post open frame rack, 44U, with 9.5 mm square holes for M6 cage nuts. Rail depth is fixed by its side frame brackets. Rated for a static load only. The AR204A is the same frame with tapped #12-24 holes.
apc/ar203a@1.name: ar203a

part-numbers.AR203A: APC NetShelter Open Frame Rack, 4 Post, 44U, Square Holes

apc/ar3100b2@1.description: The APC NetShelter SX second-generation cabinet, 42U, 600 mm wide and 1070 mm deep, in black. It has a perforated front door, a split pair of rear doors, two side panels a side, a removable roof and two zero-U accessory channels at the rear. Its rails adjust in 6 mm steps. It stands on four casters and four levelling feet.
apc/ar3100b2@1.name: ar3100b2

part-numbers.AR3100B2: APC NetShelter SX Server Rack Gen2, 42U, 600 mm wide, 1070 mm deep, with sides

chatsworth/13853-x03@1.description: The Chatsworth SeismicFrame two-post rack, a welded steel 44U frame for 19 in equipment, with two pairs of tapped #12-24 zinc-plated rails that sit 6 in or 3 in apart. The maker rates it for 1000 lb (453.6 kg) as a seismic Zone 4 load under GR-63-CORE; that is a seismic rating, not a static load, and is not written as one. It is secured to the structural floor with seismic-rated anchors and is painted black or gray, or glacier white.
chatsworth/13853-x03@1.name: 13853-x03

part-numbers.13853-X03: SeismicFrame Two-Post Rack, 7 ft (2.1 m) x 19 in, 44U, tapped

chatsworth/55053-x03@1.description: The Chatsworth Standard Rack, a 45U two-post frame of bolted aluminium extrusion with one pair of C-shaped channels carrying tapped #12-24 holes. It is sold in clear aluminium or painted black, gray or glacier white, and must be secured to the building structure. The X in the part number stands for the colour.
chatsworth/55053-x03@1.name: 55053-x03

part-numbers.55053-X03: Standard Rack, 7 ft (2.1 m) x 19 in, 45U

eaton/srw12u@1.description: The Eaton (Tripp Lite) SmartRack SRW12U, a 12U steel wall-mount cabinet in black powder coat, 600 mm wide and 450 mm deep. It has a lockable, removable, reversible vented front door and two lockable, removable vented side panels. The two vertical rails adjust in 7/8 in steps and take square holes or 12-24 threaded holes. It has a cable access port with a removable cover in the top and in the bottom, four ventilation fan ports for the optional SRFANWM fan kit, and a removable mounting plate that hooks the cabinet to the wall. It can instead roll on the optional SRCASTER caster kit. The door, the panels, the fan ports, the casters and the wall fixing are described here and are not data yet: the rack product has no key for an enclosure or a base.
eaton/srw12u@1.name: srw12u

part-numbers.SRW12U: SmartRack 12U Low-Profile Switch-Depth Wall-Mount Small Rack Enclosure Cabinet

eaton/srw12us@1.description: The Eaton (Tripp Lite) SmartRack SRW12US, a 12U steel wall cabinet in black with a perforated front door. The front door is lockable, removable and reversible. Two lockable, removable side panels close the sides. Four vertical mounting rails adjust, the front and rear sets independently, in 6 mm steps, and each rail has square holes on one face and tapped holes on the other. A cable entry with a removable cover is in the top, and another is in the back door. Four fan ports take the optional SRFANWM fan kit. A hinged wall bracket with keyhole slots holds the cabinet to the wall, with the keyholes 16 in apart, and the cabinet swings away from the wall on its hinge for rear access. The optional SRCASTER kit puts four casters under it. The door, the side panels, the fan ports, the swing, the wall fixing and the casters are described here and are not data yet: the rack product has no key for an enclosure or a base.
eaton/srw12us@1.name: srw12us

part-numbers.SRW12US: SmartRack 12U Low-Profile Switch-Depth Wall-Mount Small Rack Enclosure, Hinged Back

fs/fs-dr-8u@1.description: The FS 8U free-standing desktop rack, a two-post open frame in black powder-coated steel. Its G-shape posts have square holes and lean back from a base bracket, 81 degrees to the base in the data sheet's side view. Equipment mounts on the front rail only and the data sheet gives its depth as open. It is rated for a static load only. The lean-back angle and the base are described here and are not data yet: the rack product has no key for either.
fs/fs-dr-8u@1.name: fs-dr-8u

fs/fs-or4p-45u@1.description: The FS GF4-Series four-post open frame rack, 45U, with square-punched rails and a rear rail that sets in one-inch steps from 22 to 40 in behind the front rail. Casters and levelling feet are supplied. Rated for a static load only.
fs/fs-or4p-45u@1.name: fs-or4p-45u

fs/fs-or4p-xxu@1.description: The FS GF4-Series four-post open frame rack sold as a customized listing in 42U or 45U, with square-punched rails. The datasheet prints no height, so 42 is a stand-in, and no rail depth range, so the range is the 45U frame's stated as a reading. The FS-OR4P-45U is the same frame at 45U with its own drawing.
fs/fs-or4p-xxu@1.name: fs-or4p-xxu

generic/2-post-frame@1.description: A generic two-post open frame: two uprights, equipment on the front rail only. Its numbers are the Rack Builder's generic two-post frame, with the hole centres and opening a 19-inch rail has.
generic/2-post-frame@1.name: 2-post-frame

generic/4-post-cabinet@1.description: The rail geometry of a generic enclosed four-post cabinet, with the rail depth set in steps where a cabinet is built. Doors, panels and zero-U channels are a maker's and are not stated here.
generic/4-post-cabinet@1.name: 4-post-cabinet

generic/4-post-frame@1.description: A generic four-post open frame: front and rear rails, with the rail depth set where a frame is built. Its numbers are the Rack Builder's generic four-post frame, with the hole centres and opening a 19-inch rail has.
generic/4-post-frame@1.name: 4-post-frame

startech/4postrack12a@1.description: The StarTech.com 12U open frame rack, four posts in black steel with L-shape rails that have square holes for cage nuts. The rails are adjustable for a variable mounting depth. It ships flat pack with four swiveling casters, which raise the frame to 657 mm, and it is not wall-mountable. The casters are described here and are not data yet: the rack product has no key for a base.
startech/4postrack12a@1.name: 4postrack12a

part-numbers.4POSTRACK12A: 12U 4 Post Server Equipment Open Frame Rack Cabinet w/ Adjustable Posts & Casters

startech/4postrack42@2.description: The StarTech.com 42U open frame rack, four posts in black steel with L-shape rails that have square holes for cage nuts. The corner beams slide along the centre beam and set in one-inch steps from 22 to 40 in of mounting depth. It ships flat pack with four casters and four leveling feet, and has a base plate with floor-anchoring holes, an M6 grounding hole inside the base with four grounding wires, and 24 cable management hooks that screw on along the back of the rack. It is not wall-mountable. The casters, feet, base plate and hooks are described here and are not data yet: the rack product has no key for a base or for cable management.
startech/4postrack42@2.name: 4postrack42

startech/rk1219walloh@1.description: The StarTech.com 12U hinged open frame wall rack, in black steel with L-shape rails that have square holes for cage nuts. The frame has two front vertical rails and two rear vertical rails, and ships fully assembled with 48 #10-32 cage nuts and screws. Four anchor points on the rear panel fix it to a wall, 16 in apart centre to centre. Two latches hold the front frame to the wall bracket. With the latches released the whole frame swings out toward its hinge for rear access. The wall fixing, the hinge and the swing are described here and are not data yet: the rack product has no key for them.
startech/rk1219walloh@1.name: rk1219walloh

part-numbers.RK1219WALLOH: 4-Post 12U Hinged Wall-Mount Network Rack, 19" Open Frame Server Rack with 19.8in Mounting Depth

ubiquiti/uacc-rack-12u-wall-450-g@1.description: The Ubiquiti 12U wall-mount rack cabinet with a tempered glass front door, 450 mm deep, in white powder-coated SPCC steel. The door swings out to the left and is reversible. It has two solid, removable, lockable side panels, a door lock, four side panel locks and two keys, two pre-installed 120 x 120 x 38 mm AC fans, and grounding lugs. The cable openings are 350 x 100 mm in the rear wall and 336.5 x 52.5 mm in the top and in the bottom. The mounting depth of the square-holed posts is 283 mm as shipped and adjusts to 305 mm in a 22 mm pitch. The door, the panels, the fans and the cable openings are described here and are not data yet: the rack product has no key for an enclosure.
ubiquiti/uacc-rack-12u-wall-450-g@1.name: uacc-rack-12u-wall-450-g
